desc: 奶油海报板与墨黑相框里的琥珀色块街头儿童无袖卫衣两件套展示
leaf: 儿童无袖卫衣背心短裤两件套
name: 街头海报儿童无袖卫衣套装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼立住无袖背心加短裤的套装轮廓，干净合规承接点击。
主图一秒法则：用一处主张讲清无袖背心叠穿内搭的清爽比例。
shots.textZone: 上部墨黑场留一行主张槽，写 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 放大闷热厚叠穿的不适，把无袖背心套装立成轻盈解法。
shots.textZone: 两栏上缘各留一行短标签槽，写 「{selling_point_2}」 与 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 把套装放进球场出街场景，让买家代入孩子的日常穿搭。
用罗纹圆领与织纹微距让做工自己说话，替代任何无法验证的面料表述。
承接原页尺码信息位但全部留空待填，消除尺码疑虑而不搬运任何数值。
shots.textZone: 卡片头部留一个标题槽，写 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 同一光位看完正背关系，并留下空配色方格供实际 SKU 填充。
shots.textZone: 顶部奶油横幅留一行色名槽，写 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 以空白洗护格与空印框承载信任位，绝不生成任何检测内容与编号。
shots.textZone: 下部留注记条写 「{callout_4}」，五个洗护格中心全部留空

shots.intent: 以琥珀几何色块收口促单，留出空按钮位与主张槽等待真实信息填充。
shots.textZone: 左上留一行收口主张槽写 「{selling_point_3}」，右下空按钮位写 「{callout_5}」

style.backgroundSystem: poster-like stage set: one warm cream rounded poster field #F4EDE0 as the recurring light ground, deep ink charcoal #232329 as frame and dark ground, soft studio grey #D8DDE2 for seamless model shots, one sun-warmed outdoor court pavement variant for the single scene frame; flat amber blocks #F2B705 only ever enter as rectangular layout devices, never as full scenery
style.direction: street-editorial kidswear commerce built as poster pages: cream rounded panels, deep ink frames and flat amber geometric blocks around clean studio garment shots
style.iconSystem: flat solid geometric layout devices only: dot-grid rows of small ink dots, thin ink frames, rectangular amber blocks and empty square outline cells; no circular badge, no ribbon, no laurel, no certificate border
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with broad bounce fill, one soft contact shadow under every hem, neutral 5200K on the scene frame; a narrow skimming light band is allowed only on the neckline macro; no harsh speculars, no coloured gels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent street-editorial children's apparel system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm cream poster field #F4EDE0, deep ink charcoal #232329, one amber block accent #F2B705 and soft studio grey #D8DDE2; bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, broad bounce fill and one soft contact shadow, 5200K on the scene frame; bold geometric sans-serif display capitals paired with one clean humanist sans for labels; flat solid geometric layout devices only, dot-grid rows, thin ink frames and rectangular amber blocks, never circular badges or ribbons; the sleeveless vest, inner tee and shorts always read as one set at one locked scale; in-image Chinese appears only as bracketed selling-point or callout placeholders inside a declared copy zone; every worn body is a generic child cropped below the neck or seen from behind; no palette drift, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented certification.
noDrift: no palette drift beyond cream #F4EDE0, ink #232329, amber #F2B705 and grey #D8DDE2
no mixed fonts, no script or serif display
no random backgrounds, no furnished interiors replacing the poster-studio system
no inconsistent lighting direction between screens
no identifiable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics
style.presentationRules: the sleeveless vest, inner tee and shorts always read as one set at one locked scale, hero scale never shifting more than five percent between screens; the rectangular chest print position is named structurally and never redrawn; every worn frame uses a generic child body cropped below the neck or seen from behind, never an identifiable face
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio sweep #D8DDE2 for worn frames, matte cream poster board #F4EDE0 for flat lays and trust screens, matte ink panel #232329 for dark screens; no wood grain, no marble, no turf, no rattan
style.typography: bold geometric sans-serif display capitals used only as graphic bands that never carry a fact, plus one clean humanist sans for every Chinese label; headline 28-46pt, label 11-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; in-image Chinese appears only as bracketed selling-point or callout placeholders inside a declared copy zone
